reason: The mess is real, my site receipts are scattered across Telegram and my partner asks about them every month. But I am not putting an unknown bot into groups where we talk about suppliers, cash and clients just because it says it only reads receipts.
objection: It still sits in my work chats and touches my Google Drive. 'Only the sheet it creates' is a promise from a company I have never heard of, and if it leaks, my partner and my suppliers' numbers go with it.
would_change_my_mind: Another contractor in Bali I know showing me it has run clean in his groups for a few months, or a way to just forward receipts to the bot myself without adding it to the group.
